service_at_issue: Fixed-wing air ambulance (A0430) and 243 air miles (A0435) from an Indian Health Service clinic to a hospital in Arizona for GI bleeding
outcome_note: Ambulance transport was covered but limited to ground rates for 136 miles to the nearest capable facility; the extra 107 miles were not covered.
facts: On October 17, 2008, the appellant transported the beneficiary via air ambulance from *** Indian Health Service Clinic, in ***, Arizona, to Good Samaritan Hospital in ***, Arizona, due to gastrointestinal bleeding and acute abdominal pain. Exh. 4.
There is no evidence of record to suggest that the originating facility, an outpatient clinic, was able to treat the beneficiary’s condition.
